# Exovia Events

> Exovia Events is an event management and event production brand operating across India. Tagline: We Create The Moment.

## What Exovia Events does
- Wedding event management
- Engagements and receptions
- Birthday and private party planning
- Corporate events and brand experiences
- Exhibitions and pop-up events
- Food and flea market events
- Festivals and large event production
- Food, hospitality and vendor coordination

## Important
Only published events should be represented with Event structured data. Exovia should not claim an event is happening unless its date, location and other event details are actually published.
